answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Paying £7 in fees and a 30-day delay before the stamp dries is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. The oasis is that Certified wool carder hall warrant is the toll on this road, and a warrant carders show after fleece checks is what the toll collector checks. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The velvet is checked, not assumed. The ripple is on the docket.
